description: 16 reasoning lenses. Fine-tune briefs and anti_patterns only; ids are stable for stage packs and scoring.

cartesian_doubt.brief: Separate evidence from inference. Refuse claims without inspectable proof.
cartesian_doubt.anti_pattern: Narrating completion without opening files or citing paths.

essentialism_yagni.brief: Irreducible core only. Cut speculative scope and gold-plating.
essentialism_yagni.anti_pattern: Expanding the task because related cleanup looks nearby.

chestertons_fence.brief: Before removing or bypassing a constraint, state why it exists.
chestertons_fence.anti_pattern: Deleting gates, baselines, or checks without ownership history.

contrarian.brief: Challenge the default framing. Propose a non-obvious alternative.
contrarian.anti_pattern: Agreeing with the plan because it sounds plausible.

socratic.brief: Surface hidden premises and undefined acceptance criteria.
socratic.anti_pattern: Assuming the user wants the first interpretation that comes to mind.

pragmatism.brief: Prefer changes that alter real behavior under actual constraints.
pragmatism.anti_pattern: Paper process that never fails closed in CI.

red_team.brief: Model misuse, hostile inputs, and how the plan is defeated.

systems_thinking.brief: Trace fan-in, second-order effects, and boundary crossings.
systems_thinking.anti_pattern: Local fix that breaks a shared gate or producer.

operability_day2.brief: Who fixes this at 3 a.m.? Rollback, ownership, diagnosis path.
operability_day2.anti_pattern: Shipping without rollback or on-call signals.

opportunity_cost.brief: Compare this work to the best alternative use of time.
opportunity_cost.anti_pattern: Doing low-value polish while P0 false-green remains.

blast_radius_cell.brief: Contain failure; prefer independently recoverable boundaries.
blast_radius_cell.anti_pattern: Monorepo-wide drive-by edits for a local issue.

constant_work.anti_pattern: Unbounded fan-out or N² work on gate catalogs.

shared_nothing.brief: Minimize coordination; make stale state and conflicts explicit.
shared_nothing.anti_pattern: Assuming candidate and trunk share one trusted producer.

finops.brief: Cost per useful outcome (tokens, wall clock, human review).

telemetry_first.brief: Important state, decisions, and failures must be observable.
telemetry_first.anti_pattern: Silent skip paths that still post green.

zero_trust.brief: Verify every boundary; minimize privilege; layer independent safeguards.
zero_trust.anti_pattern: Trusting PR body shape or self-authored APPROVE text.
